q: How much does a peer programme cost?
a: That depends on the format, the size of your target group and the level of support you want. The best way to find out is together: book a no-obligation intro call, after which you will receive a concrete quote for setup and operation. We will also look at which funding options are available for your project.

q: Do we need in-house IT expertise?
a: No. restful takes care of the platform, hosting, maintenance and further development. You need one person to coordinate the programme. We train them.

q: How much work stays with us?
a: Your organisation provides one person for coordination. They review new requests, match suitable peers and are the point of contact for your members. How much time this takes depends on the size of the programme. We clarify the effort together during the pilot.

The programme belongs to your organisation. We process your members’ data on your behalf, in line with the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP), and use it only to operate the programme and for the agreed reporting. Members decide for themselves what they share and can remain anonymous. You receive anonymised reports.

q: Can we fund the programme through third-party funding?
a: Often, yes, for example through foundations or funding programmes. One example is the “Prevention in Healthcare” project funding of Health Promotion Switzerland, which funds the Swiss Sleep Circle. We explicitly support you with this: with fundraising as a service, we can take over the search for suitable funders, the concept and the application. Melanie Spescha brings the necessary experience as a fundraising expert. In an intro call, we will look together at which options suit your programme.
